Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: At the end of the course, Professor Jones told us that we were the best class he had ever had. That's why I'm sure that the 0.0 the appeared on my grade report is a mistake. Surely, if we were as good a class as Professor Jones said we were, none of us deserved to fail.

Options: 
A. Appeal to Gallery (Provicialism)
B. Fallacy of Composition
C. Red Herring
D. Appeal to Authority
E. Straw Man
F. Fallacy of Division
G. Slippery Slope
H. Appeal to Ignorance
I. False Dilemma
J. Questionable Cause

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
